load-pdf-extract-acroform-fields.title: Load PDF and Extract AcroForm Fields
load-pdf-extract-acroform-fields.description: Shows how to load a PDF file with Aspose.Pdf, access its AcroForm, and enumerate each form field to display its name and current value.

read-acroform-fields-from-pdf-stream.title: Read AcroForm Fields from PDF Stream
read-acroform-fields-from-pdf-stream.description: Shows how to open a PDF as a read‑only stream and use Aspose.Pdf to enumerate AcroForm fields without saving the file to disk.

retrieve-acroform-fields-from-pdf.title: Retrieve AcroForm Fields from PDF
retrieve-acroform-fields-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, access its AcroForm, and enumerate all form fields, displaying each field's name, type, and value.

retrieve-pdf-form-field-value.title: Retrieve PDF Form Field Value by Name
retrieve-pdf-form-field-value.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, access its AcroForm collection, retrieve a specific form field using the Document.Form indexer, and read the field's value.

list-form-fields-per-pdf-page.title: List Form Fields on Each PDF Page
list-form-fields-per-pdf-page.description: Loads a PDF document, iterates through all pages, and prints the names of any form fields present on each page.

enumerate-pdf-form-fields.title: Enumerate PDF Form Fields on a Page
enumerate-pdf-form-fields.description: Loads a PDF, accesses a specific page, and lists each form field on that page with its name, type, and current value.

read-checkbox-value-to-boolean.title: Read Checkbox Value and Convert to Boolean
read-checkbox-value-to-boolean.description: Shows how to open a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, access a checkbox form field, read its Value property, and convert the string value to a Boolean.

parse-number-fields-to-decimal.title: Parse Number Fields from PDF Form to Decimal
parse-number-fields-to-decimal.description: Shows how to load a PDF form with Aspose.Pdf, iterate over NumberField entries, convert their string values to decimal using invariant culture, and perform a simple calculation.

export-pdf-form-data-to-json.title: Export PDF Form Data to JSON
export-pdf-form-data-to-json.description: Shows how to load a PDF document with Aspose.Pdf, export all form fields to a JSON string using the Form.ExportToJson method, and output the result.

export-pdf-form-data-to-json__v2.title: Export PDF Form Data to JSON File
export-pdf-form-data-to-json__v2.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extracting all form fields, and saving them as a UTF‑8 encoded JSON file on disk.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-xml.title: Export PDF Form Fields to XML
export-pdf-form-fields-to-xml.description: Loads a PDF document and saves its complete model, including form field definitions and values, to an XML file using Aspose.Pdf.

export-pdf-form-to-fdf.title: Export PDF Form Data to FDF
export-pdf-form-to-fdf.description: Shows how to extract form field values from a PDF document and write them to an FDF file using Aspose.Pdf's Form facade.

export-acroform-to-xfdf.title: Export AcroForm Fields to XFDF
export-acroform-to-xfdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, create a FileStream, and export the document's AcroForm fields (annotations) to an XFDF file.

export-pdf-to-html-png-xfdf.title: Export PDF to HTML, PNG, and XFDF with Proper Stream Disposal
export-pdf-to-html-png-xfdf.description: Demonstrates how to export a PDF document to HTML, a PNG image of the first page, and XFDF annotations while correctly closing each FileStream using using blocks.

modify-checkbox-appearance-extract-value.title: Modify Checkbox Appearance and Extract Its Value
modify-checkbox-appearance-extract-value.description: Shows how to locate a checkbox form field, draw a custom rectangle over it using Aspose.Pdf.Drawing.Graph, and then read the checkbox value before saving the modified PDF.

extract-pdf-form-field-values.title: Extract PDF Form Field Values to a Dictionary
extract-pdf-form-field-values.description: Shows how to load a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, iterate over its form fields, and return a case‑insensitive dictionary of each field's full name and string value.

export-pdf-form-data-to-json__v3.title: Export PDF Form Data to JSON Files
export-pdf-form-data-to-json__v3.description: Iterates through PDF files in a folder, loads each with Aspose.Pdf, and exports the document's form fields to a separate JSON file.

combine-pdf-form-data-into-json-array.title: Combine PDF Form Data into a Single JSON Array
combine-pdf-form-data-into-json-array.description: Demonstrates loading multiple PDF files, exporting each form's fields to JSON using Aspose.Pdf, and merging the results into a single JSON array for batch processing.

export-pdf-form-data-to-json__v4.title: Export PDF Form Data to JSON
export-pdf-form-data-to-json__v4.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and export its interactive form fields to a JSON file using a simple command‑line utility.

log-pdf-form-extraction-timestamps.title: Log PDF Form Extraction Timestamps
log-pdf-form-extraction-timestamps.description: Shows how to iterate through PDF pages, extract text from form XObjects, and capture start/end timestamps for each extraction using Aspose.Pdf.

serialize-pdf-form-data-to-json-bytes.title: Serialize PDF Form Data to JSON Byte Array
serialize-pdf-form-data-to-json-bytes.description: Loads a PDF, extracts all form fields as JSON, writes the JSON into a MemoryStream, and returns the resulting JSON as a byte array for API consumption.

export-pdf-form-fields-with-prefix-to-js.title: Export PDF Form Fields with Specific Prefix to JSON
export-pdf-form-fields-with-prefix-to-js.description: Loads a PDF, filters its form fields to only those whose names start with a given prefix, and writes the selected field names and values to a formatted JSON file.

count-acroform-fields-in-pdf.title: Count AcroForm Fields in PDF
count-acroform-fields-in-pdf.description: Loads a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and retrieves the total number of AcroForm fields using Document.Form.Count.

iterate-modify-pdf-form-fields.title: Iterate and Modify PDF Form Fields
iterate-modify-pdf-form-fields.description: Shows how to open a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, loop through each form field, read and update text box values, and save the modified document.

retrieve-pdf-form-field-types.title: Retrieve PDF Form Field Types with Aspose.Pdf
retrieve-pdf-form-field-types.description: The example loads a PDF document, accesses its AcroForm, and enumerates each form field to display its name and runtime type using Aspose.Pdf.

export-pdf-form-data-to-json__v5.title: Export PDF Form Data to JSON via Stream
export-pdf-form-data-to-json__v5.description: Shows how to load a PDF document and export its form fields directly to a JSON file using a FileStream with Aspose.Pdf's ExportToJson method.

export-pdf-form-data-to-xml.title: Export PDF Form Data to XML Using MemoryStream
export-pdf-form-data-to-xml.description: Loads a PDF, verifies the presence of form fields, and writes the form data as XML directly into a MemoryStream, then reads the XML for demonstration.

export-pdf-form-data-to-fdf.title: Export PDF Form Data to FDF Using Aspose.Pdf
export-pdf-form-data-to-fdf.description: Loads a PDF document, binds it to the Aspose.Pdf.Facades.Form facade, and exports the form fields to an FDF file via a FileStream.

export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf.title: Export PDF Annotations to XFDF using FileStream
export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, export all its annotations to an XFDF file via a FileStream, and properly close the stream.

count-form-fields-on-each-pdf-page.title: Count Form Fields on Each PDF Page
count-form-fields-on-each-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates opening a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, verifying the presence of an AcroForm, iterating through pages, and logging the number of form fields (WidgetAnnotations) found on each page.

extract-vector-graphics-to-svg.title: Extract Vector Graphics from PDF to Individual SVG Files
extract-vector-graphics-to-svg.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its pages, and extract each vector graphic as a separate SVG file using SvgExtractor.

extract-vector-graphics-to-svg__v2.title: Extract Vector Graphics from PDF Page to SVG
extract-vector-graphics-to-svg__v2.description: Shows how to load a PDF, verify a page contains vector graphics, and extract each graphic as a separate SVG file using Aspose.Pdf.

combine-pdf-page-vector-graphics-into-sv.title: Combine PDF Page Vector Graphics into a Single SVG
combine-pdf-page-vector-graphics-into-sv.description: Loads a PDF, extracts vector graphics from each page using Aspose.Pdf's SvgExtractor, and merges them into a single multi‑page SVG document.

extract-subpaths-pdf-png.title: Extract Subpaths from PDF Pages as PNG Images
extract-subpaths-pdf-png.description: Shows how to use GraphicsAbsorber to capture each SubPath graphic element on PDF pages and export each one as an individual PNG file.

export-pdf-page-as-png.title: Export PDF Page as PNG Image
export-pdf-page-as-png.description: Loads a PDF document, creates a resolution and PNG device, and rasterizes the first page to a PNG file at a specified DPI.

extract-graphic-element-as-svg.title: Extract Graphic Element as SVG from PDF
extract-graphic-element-as-svg.description: Loads a PDF, extracts vector graphic elements on a page as SVG strings, selects one by index, and saves it to an SVG file.

extract-first-page-text-to-utf8-file.title: Extract First Page Text from PDF to UTF-8 File
extract-first-page-text-to-utf8-file.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extract the text from its first page using a TextAbsorber, and save the result to a UTF‑8 encoded text file.

extract-text-from-pdf-to-txt.title: Extract Text from PDF and Save to TXT
extract-text-from-pdf-to-txt.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extract all page text using a TextAbsorber, and write the concatenated result to a UTF‑8 .txt file.

extract-pdf-stamp-texts-to-json.title: Extract Stamp Texts from PDF to JSON
extract-pdf-stamp-texts-to-json.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through its pages to find stamp annotations, extracts the visible text from each stamp, and writes the collected strings to a JSON file.

extract-superscript-subscript-from-pdf.title: Extract Superscript and Subscript from PDF with Annotations
extract-superscript-subscript-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to extract text from a PDF, detect superscript and subscript characters using font size and baseline position, and annotate them in a plain‑text output file.

extract-paragraphs-with-line-breaks.title: Extract Paragraphs with Line Breaks from PDF
extract-paragraphs-with-line-breaks.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf to absorb paragraph structures from a PDF, preserve line breaks, and save the extracted text to a UTF‑8 .txt file.

extract-images-from-pdf.title: Extract Images from PDF and Save as PNG
extract-images-from-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through each page's image resources, and saves every embedded image as a PNG file in a specified output folder.

extract-fonts-from-pdf-ttf.title: Extract Fonts from PDF and Save as TTF Files
extract-fonts-from-pdf-ttf.description: Loads a PDF document, retrieves all embedded fonts, and exports each font to a .ttf file in a designated output folder.

extract-pdf-tables-to-csv.title: Extract PDF Tables and Export to CSV
extract-pdf-tables-to-csv.description: Demonstrates how to locate tables in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, read each cell's text, and write each table to a separate CSV file with proper escaping.

export-acroform-fields-to-json.title: Export AcroForm Fields to JSON
export-acroform-fields-to-json.description: Shows how to load a PDF containing AcroForm fields and export the field names and values directly to a JSON file using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-extract-vector-graphics-to-svg.title: Batch Extract Vector Graphics from PDFs to SVG
batch-extract-vector-graphics-to-svg.description: Shows how to iterate over PDF files in a folder, detect pages containing vector graphics, and save those graphics as SVG files using Aspose.Pdf.

parallel-pdf-text-extraction.title: Parallel PDF Text Extraction with Aspose.Pdf
parallel-pdf-text-extraction.description: Demonstrates how to extract text from multiple PDF files concurrently using Aspose.Pdf and the Task Parallel Library, with cancellation support and thread‑safe result aggregation.

export-pdf-to-svg-with-custom-options.title: Export PDF to SVG with Custom Rendering Options
export-pdf-to-svg-with-custom-options.description: Shows how to save a PDF as a single SVG file and extract per‑page vector graphics while applying custom DPI‑like scaling, glyph caching, stroke width, and grouping options.

filter-export-large-graphics-pdf.title: Filter and Export Large Graphics from PDF
filter-export-large-graphics-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to absorb graphic elements from each PDF page, filter them by bounding‑box area, and export the qualifying elements as separate SVG files.

extract-graphics-from-specific-pdf-pages.title: Extract Graphics from Specific PDF Pages to SVG
extract-graphics-from-specific-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to use GraphicsAbsorber together with SvgExtractor to collect vector graphics from selected PDF pages and save them as SVG files.

combine-pdf-vectors-to-svg.title: Combine Vector Graphics from Multiple PDFs into a Single SVG
combine-pdf-vectors-to-svg.description: The example loads several PDF files, extracts vector graphics from each page using Aspose.Pdf's SvgExtractor, and merges the resulting SVG fragments into one multi‑page SVG document.

extract-subpaths-as-separate-svg.title: Extract Subpaths as Separate SVG Images
extract-subpaths-as-separate-svg.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, configuring SvgExtractionOptions to export each graphic subpath as an individual SVG file with a transparent background, and saving the results per page.

export-pdf-pages-to-svg-preserving-coord.title: Export PDF Pages to SVG Preserving Coordinate System
export-pdf-pages-to-svg-preserving-coord.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through each page, and saves any vector graphics as SVG files while keeping the original PDF coordinate system.

pdf-summary-report-text-image-count.title: PDF Summary Report: Text Length and Image Count
pdf-summary-report-text-image-count.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extracting all text to calculate character length, counting embedded images, and printing a concise summary per file.

extract-pdf-font-table-form-field-statis.title: Extract PDF Font, Table, and Form Field Statistics
extract-pdf-font-table-form-field-statis.description: Demonstrates how to open PDF files with Aspose.Pdf and count distinct fonts, tables, and AcroForm fields in each document.

validate-pdf-fonts-against-system.title: Validate PDF Fonts Against System Installation
validate-pdf-fonts-against-system.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through each page to collect fonts, and reports any fonts that are not installed on the host system using Aspose.Pdf's font accessibility check.

extract-pdf-metadata-and-save-svg.title: Extract PDF Metadata and Save as SVG
extract-pdf-metadata-and-save-svg.description: Demonstrates how to read basic PDF metadata (author, title, etc.) using Aspose.Pdf and export the document's vector content to an SVG file for documentation purposes.

extract-images-using-graphicsabsorber.title: Extract Images from PDF Using GraphicsAbsorber
extract-images-using-graphicsabsorber.description: Shows how to employ GraphicsAbsorber to locate only image objects on each PDF page and export them as JPEG files, while ignoring other graphic elements.

extract-pdf-paragraphs-to-markdown.title: Extract PDF Paragraphs to Markdown Preserving Indentation
extract-pdf-paragraphs-to-markdown.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, use ParagraphAbsorber to capture paragraph structures, and write each paragraph to a markdown file while keeping the original leading spaces.

extract-superscript-subscript-from-pdf__.title: Extract Superscript and Subscript Text from PDF
extract-superscript-subscript-from-pdf__.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extract text while preserving formatting, and prepend Unicode markers for superscript and subscript characters.

export-pdf-tables-to-csv-with-borders.title: Export PDF Tables to CSV with Visual Border Markers
export-pdf-tables-to-csv-with-borders.description: Demonstrates how to extract tables from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's TableAbsorber and write them to a CSV file while preserving cell borders with delimiter markers.

extract-checkbox-states-from-pdf.title: Extract Checkbox States from PDF AcroForm
extract-checkbox-states-from-pdf.description: Shows how to read checkbox fields from a PDF's AcroForm using Aspose.Pdf and write their checked states to a JSON file as a list of booleans.

extract-selected-radio-button-labels.title: Extract Selected Radio Button Labels from PDF Form
extract-selected-radio-button-labels.description: Loads a PDF document, iterates over its form fields, and prints the visible label of the selected option for each radio button field.

extract-svg-apply-brand-colors.title: Extract SVG Vector Graphics and Apply Brand Color Transformation
extract-svg-apply-brand-colors.description: The example loads a PDF, extracts each page's vector graphics as SVG, replaces black colors with a brand palette, and saves the transformed SVG files.
